name: Volumetric Cloud Rendering with Pre-computed Light Transmittance
definition: A volumetric rendering technique that generates fluffy clouds using ray marching on a voxel density grid, utilizing pre-computed light transmittance to accelerate the rendering equation evaluation.
summary: Volumetric Cloud Rendering with Pre-computed Light Transmittance generates clouds by ray marching through a voxel grid, accelerating rendering by decoupling light transport from per-pixel integration via pre-computed transmittance.
